topics.title: Secondary activities and the meaning of manufacturing

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how secondary activities add value to natural resources by transforming raw materials into finished products.
Distinguish the literal meaning of manufacturing from its modern meaning and from the concept of an industry.

topics.title: Characteristics of modern large scale manufacturing
topics.ncert_sections: Characteristics of Modern Large Scale Manufacturing

concepts.learning_objective: Contrast the craft method with mass production of standardised parts.
Describe mechanisation, automation, technological innovation and the organisational needs of modern manufacturing.
Interpret why modern manufacturing is concentrated in a few small areas of the world.

topics.title: Factors of industrial location and footloose industries
topics.ncert_sections: Why do Large-scale Industries choose different locations?; Foot Loose Industries

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how access to markets and to raw materials influences where industries are located.
Explain the role of labour, energy, transport, government policy and agglomeration economies in industrial location.
Identify the features and the main locational factor of footloose industries.

topics.title: Classification of industries based on size
topics.ncert_sections: Classification of Manufacturing Industries; Industries based on Size

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the features of household or cottage manufacturing.
Distinguish small scale manufacturing from household industries and state its role in employment.
Describe large scale manufacturing and the two broad types of world industrial regions.

topics.title: Classification of industries based on inputs or raw materials

concepts.learning_objective: Identify agro-based industries and explain the idea of agri-business.
Classify industries using ferrous, non-ferrous, non-metallic and chemical raw materials.
Identify raw materials that industries obtain from forests and animals.

topics.title: Classification of industries based on output and ownership
topics.ncert_sections: Industries Based On Output/Product; Industries Based on Ownership

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish basic industries from consumer goods industries using examples.
Differentiate public, private and joint sector industries.
Explain the features of high technology industry and its landscape.
Define technopolies and analyse why high-tech industries concentrate in planned areas.
